pages.text: $(thing)Rope Javelins$() are tethered throwing weapons. Charge with right-click, release to throw, then right-click again while deployed to pull the javelin back. A hit entity will be yanked towards the player.

pages.title: Capture and Retract
pages.text: On entity hit, targets can be tethered and reeled. Rope javelins also auto-retract if the tether exceeds range or a valid tether path can no longer be maintained.
